notes: MAJOR FINDING (2026-09-05 refresh, supersedes all prior notes below): this refresh set out to add weeks 14+ (the gap the 2026-08-05 refresh left open) and, while researching the current card-acquisition system to source companion cache cards, found strong primary-source evidence that the Spotlight Cache mechanic this file tracks was RETIRED on 2026-04-29 and replaced by a different system called 'Snap Packs' (weekly-updated Series 5 Packs, seasonally-updated Series 4 Packs, and Series 3/4/5 Collector's Packs, each guaranteeing 1 unowned card + 2 bonus rewards, purchased with Tokens from a 'Card Shop'). Evidence: direct fetch of the official marvelsnap.com announcement post ('Unlocking the Future of Your Collection: Snap Packs' -- Spotlight Keys converted to Tokens at 3000:1, Token Shop became the Card Shop); a real, indexed marvelsnap.com URL titled 'Patch Notes - April 29, 2025' surfaced independently in search results; corroborating secondary coverage from marvelsnapzone.com's own 'snap-packs-announcement' page, shacknews.com, snap.fan, gamerant.com, ginx.tv and sportskeeda.com, all agreeing on the April 29, 2025 date and the retirement. This directly contradicts the 2026-08-05 refresh's conclusion (see retained note below), which treated a hallucinated 'Snap Packs replaced Spotlight Caches in April 2025' search snippet as refuted -- that refresh's refutation evidence (a gamingonphone.com 'Spotlight Cache Version Update' article existing for August 2026) is now suspected to be a legacy article-series title GamingOnPhone kept reusing rather than proof the underlying mechanic still exists; it was not itself re-verified against marvelsnap.com this cycle. Given this is now a load-bearing contradiction between two refresh cycles rather than a single hallucinated snippet, and given the instruction to never fabricate or extrapolate card names or dates, this refresh is NOT adding weeks 14+ (which would need to cover 2026-08-04 through today, 2026-09-05, plus the new AXIS: Inversion season starting 2026-09-01) and is NOT attempting to translate Snap Packs data into this file's spotlight/cacheCards shape, since the two systems have materially different shapes (a pack is not a named 'spotlight card + 3 companions') and this refresh has neither the authority nor sufficiently confirmed data to redesign the schema unilaterally. RECOMMENDATION FOR MAINTAINER: before the next monthly refresh, have a human confirm directly in-game (or via an unambiguous, dated, first-party source) whether Spotlight Caches are still active as of September 2026. If retired, this file (and the 'Spotlight Calculator' / 'spotlight-schedule.json' consumer in CLAUDE.md's spec) should likely be deprecated or redesigned around Snap Packs rather than patched further; if somehow still active alongside Snap Packs, say so explicitly with a source so future refreshes stop re-litigating this. Weeks 1-13 above are left untouched (not re-verified, not deleted) pending that decision -- removing them was out of scope for a monthly data refresh. PRIOR NOTE (2026-08-05 refresh, retained for audit trail, now itself in question -- see above): GAP: weeks covering 2026-04-07 through 2026-05-26 (X-Men: End of Days / April season, Daredevil: Crimson Twilight / May season) could not be reconstructed with confidence and are intentionally omitted rather than fabricated. Weeks 5-11 (June 2 - July 21, 2026) were reconstructed from a dated raw schedule (fourthlocation.com) cross-checked against Marvel Snap Zone / GameFAQs 'Spotlight Cache Version Update' articles; cacheCards were not independently verifiable for most weeks and left empty rather than invented. Weeks 12-13 went live as scheduled and were confirmed. The season changed to Fractured Frontier on 2026-08-04. The four new Fractured Frontier Series 5 cards (Psylocke, Red Wolf, Death, Red Hulk) were confirmed but which card headlined which week (2026-08-04 onward) could not be cross-verified against two independent sources and was left unscheduled rather than guessed (previously tracked in a non-schema 'pendingWeeks' key, removed this cycle to match the required key set: lastUpdated, notes, scheduleVersion, season, weeks).
